description: EdDSA on an Ed25519 key with alg Ed25519 and an Ed25519 key without alg returns the key without alg; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): a member alg must equal the selector's exactly, and EdDSA is not Ed25519; both members are Ed25519 (§2.1), neither has use or key_ops; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
